title: The August 17 outage
summary: GitHub's official post-mortem analysis of the August 17 service outage, detailing the incident timeline, root cause analysis, and comprehensive remediation plan to prevent similar failures in the future.
problem_solved: Major platform outage affecting millions of developers' ability to access and deploy code.
why_valuable: Demonstrates GitHub's commitment to transparency and incident accountability, providing valuable lessons for site reliability engineering practices.
